title: 'finflow' Weekly Economic Calendar with pastel glass day cards and currency bubbles

whatItMeans: Light and approachable; soft glass cards make dense economic data feel friendly.
techniques: Size day cards by importance with the key day largest.
Show currencies as white circle bubbles.
Fade outer days to focus the week.
Follow the visual with a dated two-column list.
